steps.title: How does a game of Ludo start?

items.title: Pick your colour
items.text: Yellow, green, pink or cyan: the other three colours are played by bots.

items.title: Roll to see who starts
items.text: The highest number starts. In case of a tie, only the tied players roll again until there is a single winner.

items.title: Aim for a six
items.text: Each player rolls the die up to three times in a row, until one of them gets a six.

items.title: Off you go!
items.text: The game is on. Bring your pawns out and get all four of them home. Good luck!
